label: Primary school enrolment, gross enrolment ratio (UIS)
source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (UIS), indicator GER.1
notes: Total enrolment in primary education, whatever the age, divided by the population of the age group that officially corresponds to that level, in percent. It can exceed 100 when pupils are older or younger than the official age or repeat grades. Values flagged by UIS as UIS or national estimates are kept. Country rows only: UIS regional and grouped units are not ISO3 countries and are left out. UNESCO Institute for Statistics API, February 2026 data release, retrieved 2026-10-05. Tertiary enrolment is not added here: the Hub already holds it as SE.TER.ENRR (World Bank copy of the same UIS series, same values for Lebanon).
